meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按任务挑选执行、指挥、评审三类智能体组成团队,让它们轮流发言、辩论并共享同一份数据库记忆,最后汇总输出团队结果与决策过程记录。
howto.when: 当需要多个智能体协同完成复杂任务时触发,例如评估技术方案、构建 OPC 系统、制定定价策略等;任务简单时也可只用单个智能体。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构方案
say.note: 你会看到主持人引导、各角色发言辩论并形成共识

say.text: 请用 OPC 团队构建 AI 短视频领域的系统
say.note: 依次输出机会分析、产品蓝图和可运行代码

say.text: 请用产品团队制定某产品的定价策略
say.note: 市场分析、成本核算与定价讨论全程可见

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude picks execution, command, and review agents to form a team; they speak, debate, and share one database memory, then it outputs the combined result and decision record.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a complex task needs several agents working together, such as evaluating a tech plan, building an OPC system, or setting pricing; simple tasks can use one agent.

say_en.text: Use the tech decision team to evaluate the microservices architecture
say_en.note: You see the host lead, agents debate, and reach consensus

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for AI short videos
say_en.note: Outputs opportunity analysis, blueprint, and runnable code

say_en.text: Use the product team to set pricing for this product
say_en.note: Market analysis, cost review, and pricing talk are shown
